label: Preferences · Section Hub
description: Approved nine-destination hub. Your Health and Settings appear first; Connections & Account continues below.

label: Preferences · Lower Groups
description: The same hub scrolled to show Settings and Connections & Account.

label: Health Profile
description: Your Goals, About You, Conditions, and Medications share one predictable destination. Existing editor rows are placement references.

label: Tracking & Routines
description: What to Track, Symptoms, logging preferences, and a contextual route to the shared reminder overview.

label: Tracking · Cycle Available
description: Cycle Settings is shown only when available and enabled. This example does not extend eligibility or cloud sharing.

label: Quick Log & Widgets
description: Saved reusable entries are separated from Quick Capture, which continues to widget pins, learned habits, and suggestions.

label: AI Insights & Chat
description: Separate cloud explanation/plan, chat, and alcohol-sharing controls. Example values are not production defaults; native opt-in still requires complete consent disclosure.

label: AI · Sharing Details
description: Expanded sharing information illustrates disclosure grouping. Final consent wording and native authorization flows retain their existing governing contracts.

label: Reminders
description: One master preference with routes to the existing Sleep, medication, and Daily Check-In schedules. Permission-state and editor details require further design.

label: Appearance
description: System, Light, and Dark remain separate choices. Both references show the same illustrative System selection.

label: Your Progress
description: Logging points, streaks, and badges remain separate from health findings and AI.

label: Health Connections
description: iPhone organization example. Existing connection, consent, permission, and disconnection controls must remain in the complete native flow.

label: Account & Privacy
description: Account identity, provider-managed security, export, and policy routes. This is a navigation reference, not a replacement account form.

label: Account · Privacy & Actions
description: Contextual privacy links plus explicit Log Out and Delete Account buttons. Existing confirmation and deletion boundaries remain mandatory.
